item.title: SVD — how much does a rectangular matrix stretch each direction?
item.description: A neural network weight matrix can map 32 input features to 96 outputs. Asking whether its output points along its input makes little sense when the two live in different spaces. We can still ask a concrete question. Among unit-length inputs, which one produces the longest output?
